overall_reason: A release-checklist card with a weighted title over quieter meta, task rows on one name-and-status grid, and a footer that puts the count on the left line and the action on the right.

score.reason: T-SQUINT passes (title, then Open project, then rows) and T-LEFT-EDGES finds one left line at x=413 and one right line at x=663 for every row, with a hairline parting the footer; what was cut is any second alignment axis and any status column that is not shared.

strengths: Every row's status ends on x=663, the same right line as the Open project button.
The title (14px, weight 550) sits 2px above its 11px meta, so the head reads as one item.
A hairline and 12px of space part the list from the footer, so the action belongs to the card, not to the last row.
not_investigated: 00-contract.md is absent, so no audience, visitor mode or brief overrides were read; the item is judged as the single UI composition it is (an Operate-style component).

T-FIVE-SECOND fold check, T-SCREEN-BY-SCREEN beyond the single tile, T-HEADINGS-READ, T-COMPOSITION-RUN, T-STOCK-ORDER and T-ANATOMY were not run: the artifact is one composition on one screen with no section sequence.
Colour, type sizes, contrast and copy belong to other lenses and the sweep; they are not judged here.
